Welcome
UC Santa Cruz is a world-renowned leader in astronomy and astrophysics. We are innovators of telescope technology, creators of new research methods, and pioneers in using the world’s fastest supercomputers. From planets to stars to galaxies to cosmology, we have made some of the biggest discoveries in the field and have received some of the highest honors.
Undergraduate students have the opportunity to be involved in this cutting-edge research—a defining feature of our programs. The Astronomy & Astrophysics Department offers dynamic degree programs tailored to your goals. Explore our graduate and undergraduate programs to find which path is right for you. We are committed to support a diverse community and an inclusive environment that promotes innovation and scientific excellence.
In the News
Discover the latest breakthroughs, honors, and stories that showcase the people, research, and impact of UC Santa Cruz Astronomy & Astrophysics.
Tesla Jeltema named a 2026 American Physical Society Fellow
Jeltema’s work focuses on observational cosmology and particle astrophysics, including constraints on the nature of dark matter and dark energy and studies of the evolution of galaxies.
October 13, 2026
US Higher Education and the Future of Society: A panel discussion
Sponsored by the UCSC Earth Futures institute, the panel discussion will be at 3:30 p.m. on October 27 in the Dougherty Reading Room in the Science & Engineering Library.
October 9, 2026
Astronomers use Webb telescope to pinpoint host galaxy of the most distant fast radio burst to date
Originating just 3 billion years after the Big Bang, the record-setting burst was localized with key contributions from UC Santa Cruz collaborators.
